We need to use the vehicle control system tool to fill fuel tank. We need to know current fuel level. There\'s no tool to get current fuel level directly. But we can estimate: The tank holds up to 50 gallons. If we want to double current fuel, we need to add enough fuel to reach twice current. But we don\'t know current.
